Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. In this leadership role, the Retail Lead, FT supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Retail Lead, FT serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. foundryforgood-foundry-for-good:ashbyhq:.description: Be Part of a Mission-Driven Team At Foundry for Good, we don’t just build businesses—we build businesses that do good. Across our family of brands, we support nonprofits, trade associations, and mission-driven organizations with innovative software, impactful marketing strategies, and tools that empower positive change. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a difference, we’d love to hear from you! Watch Our "Meet the Team" Video https://vimeo.com/1059846216/d84c59a1e7?share=copy JOB DESCRIPTION In this role you’ll be in daily contact with leading nonprofit technology and consulting companies from across the nation and the world to help build and facilitate partnerships, integrations, and marketing that our nonprofit clients rely on. THE POSITION: This is the perfect role for someone who has recently graduated or is early in their career. We’re looking to hire candidates who have 0-3 years experience, an interest in the nonprofit sector, and a desire to build and maintain relationships with a wide variety of people and companies. You’ll be in daily contact with leading nonprofit technology and consulting companies from across the nation and the world. On any given day, you could speak with the CEO of a fast-paced philanthropic startup, a senior developer from the largest social good technology firm in the world, and the marketing content coordinator from a social fundraising platform processing billions of dollars in donations every year — all before lunch! As a Partnership Success Specialist, your responsibility is to assist in the building and maintenance of the most important relationships our nonprofit clients rely on to keep their technology solutions up and running. The ideal candidate is excited to represent themselves and Double the Donation to external parties, whether that means presenting a product demo to a team of engineers or coordinating a webinar with an invitee list in the tens of thousands. The best candidates are fantastic written and verbal communicators, quick learners, and skilled researchers. In this role, you will: - Spend large portions of your day talking to people in a wide range of positions at nonprofit technology companies - Present marketing ideas and strategies that are beneficial for our company, our nonprofit clients, and our partners - Coordinate technical, marketing, and commercial conversations and produce supporting materials - Prioritize a large amount of possible daily tasks down to a list of essential tasks - Represent yourself and the company over the phone, in emails, and sometimes in person - Negotiate contracts and close deals Requirements Location - This is a work-from-home setup. - It is a night shift schedule (8am to 5pm EST) Who we’re looking for: - Individuals looking for entry level positions (Majors that could be a good fit include Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism, English, Nonprofit Management, Public Administration, or other Liberal Arts degrees) - Strong academic performance with an overall 3.9 GWA minimum - Individuals who take their professional achievements very seriously As a small growing business, there are a few traits unique to our business that individuals should consider before applying. - You must love the idea of giving back to the community and nonprofits. There are thousands of jobs. If being involved in the success of nonprofits is something you’re truly passionate about, this could be a great role.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:8ac51372-.description: Senior Principal Product Manager – Ecosystem, Partnerships & Distribution About Gen We're not just a company; we're a global force. Fiercely committed to ensuring that everyone, everywhere, can live their lives digitally safe. Our family of brands, Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender and CCleaner, unite the brightest minds, the sharpest tech and the most diverse thinking to protect over 500 million people. And we've built an inclusive workplace, where your well-being is a priority because true success comes from a place of balance and authenticity. When you're thriving, you're unstoppable. So, bring us your bold ideas and passion that refuses to quit. The digital world isn't some distant reality, it's the world we live in, and we're ready for it. If you're ready to push boundaries and be part of something bigger, join #TeamGen. About the Team The Security Product team owns product direction across Norton and Gen's wider security and utility portfolio, working across brands on complex problems at the intersection of threat intelligence, platform evolution, and consumer experience. The team operates with high autonomy, high accountability, and a genuine appetite for ambiguity. The Role This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor role responsible for Gen Digital's ecosystem strategy — how we protect, grow, and extend our business across external platforms, partners, and emerging distribution channels. As platform ecosystems, AI, and agentic technologies reshape how consumers access and interact with security products, this role ensures Gen Digital stays ahead — maintaining leadership across existing channels while opening new ones. What You'll Do Ecosystem Strategy and Business Continuity Own Gen Digital's strategy across app stores, operating systems, and device ecosystems. Continuously assess platform policy changes, API shifts, and capability updates and translate them into clear product implications before competitors do. Protect and grow our core business by managing platform risks and opportunities proactively, ensuring our products remain compatible, performant, and differentiated. Partnership and Capability Extension Gen Digital builds market-leading scam protection, identity defence, and security products — and extends those capabilities further through strategic external partnerships. Identify and develop partnerships with chip vendors for on-device intelligence and deepfake protection, call protection providers, DNS and network partners for safe browsing, and financial ecosystem players for fraud protection. Co-develop integrated experiences across device, network, and platform layers, and define partnership models — technical integrations, co-innovation, and joint go-to-market — that scale. Distribution in an AI-Driven World Consumers are increasingly interacting with technology through AI platforms and agentic interfaces rather than traditional app stores. Identify and define new distribution opportunities across AI platforms including OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, and Anthropic, and across agentic ecosystems and marketplaces. Develop strategies to embed Gen Digital protections into AI-native workflows and ensure Gen is positioned early as the interface layer evolves. Industry Representation and Influence Represent Gen Digital in key industry forums including Microsoft Ignite, Google I/O, GASA, and the Aspen Institute. Advocate for consumer safety standards, fair platform policies, and security-forward ecosystem design. Build the external credibility to shape industry direction and regulatory frameworks. Cross-functional Leadership Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy, and GTM teams around ecosystem strategy. Act as the bridge between external partners and internal execution teams, and lead effectively in high-ambiguity, high-stakes situations where direction is being defined, not just followed. What We're Looking For Proven experience in consumer technology or security
